# Nuvion Solutions

> Nuvion Solutions is a web-design and local-SEO studio based in Santa Rosa, California, serving Sonoma County, the San Francisco Bay Area, and all of California. Real people design, build, and host custom, high-converting websites for local small businesses. You see a free mockup first and only pay once your site is live and you love it. Sites go live in about a week, you own your website, and a real person answers the same day. Bilingual — English and Spanish.

## Key facts
- Business: Nuvion Solutions — independent web-design & local-SEO studio (not a large agency; you work directly with the people building your site).
- Location: Santa Rosa, CA. Service area: Sonoma County, San Francisco Bay Area, and all of California.
- Team: Jaeden Callender (co-founder) and David Prudhomme (Sales & Business Development).
- Services: Web design, website redesign, local SEO, custom builds & web apps, integrations & automation, and marketing.
- Signature offer: A free website mockup built before you pay — you only pay once the site is live and you love it, and the site is yours to keep.
- Timeline: Custom sites go live in about one week once content is ready.
- Pricing: Custom websites start at $600 one-time (Launch $600, Business $900, Growth from $1,800), or $49/month with $0 down (yours to keep after 18 months). Optional care plan (hosting, security, backups) from $29/month. You get a written quote before you owe a cent.
- Differentiators: One real local person, start to finish; same-day answers; you own your site; no templates or bots; bilingual (EN/ES).
- Contact: team@nuvion-solutions.com · (707) 520-9179 · https://www.nuvion-solutions.com

## Common questions
- Is the mockup really free? Yes — 100% free, no card, no obligation. You see a real mockup of your site before deciding anything.
- When do I pay? Only once your site is live and you love it. Nothing upfront, no deposit.
- Do I own my website? Yes — it's yours to keep, and you're never locked in.
- How fast is it? You see a free mockup within a few days, and your site goes live in about a week.
- Where are you located? Santa Rosa, California — serving Sonoma County, the Bay Area, and all of California.
